entities.summary: Novgorod Republic, a political institution in Russia during Kievan Rus' & Christianisation (1054–1240). Grew from Sophia Cathedral and Baptism of Rus' & Kievan Golden Age. Led to the emergence of Fragmentation of Kievan Rus'.
